detail.quote: It then goes horizontally to (-11.9139, 26.60454), forming a horizontal line.
detail.explanation: The coordinate pair begins a new `M` command, so it starts a separate subpath; no line is drawn from the previous endpoint to (-11.9139, 26.60454). The candidate also incorrectly calls the segment horizontal. This misreads which lines are actually present and undermines its shape analysis and final choice.
